notes.title: Demo Update 3
notes.content:
Demo Update 3 Patch Notes:
This is probably the last demo update asides from patches etc.
New Stuff:
- Lighting  

- Saving and loading!

- All soundtracks are now made entirely by myself!

- Most graphic assets have been remade 

- In world time changes based on your progress in the story 

- Indication of when the chapter changes 

- New puzzle after acquiring the Pickaxe - Dialogue system rework     

- Portraits, text backdrop, alternate forms 

- Caves now have new decoration (stalagmites, etc) 

- Can now switch between a toggle and a hold for wheel usage 


Changes:
- Altered dialogue in certain points in the game 

- Changed the tutorial for using the Ring and Glove 

- A variety of small changes to different areas 

- Movement altered a little (feels more slippery per se, especially in snowy areas)  

- Zoom in during dialogue

- Hopefully cleared up some areas that people get stuck in.


Fixes:
- Optimisation 

- Patched a potential soft lock with resetting and changing areas at the same time (hopefully) 

- Fixed getting stuck next to walls in icy areas.  


Roadmap:
- None







[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938144/7bbf13191622d36ee1908589cdbc39aeadde7c2d.png"]

Hopefully I haven't screwed something over with this update.

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.content:
Demo Update 2 Patch Notes:

New Stuff:
- Revamp of platform inventory/wheel system.
- Experimental bloom feature accessible in the options menu
- New soundtracks for different locations (Caves, Mountains,[spoiler] Underworld [/spoiler],[spoiler] Tunnel [/spoiler]
- New sound effects
- A little more content before the Rift happens


Changes:
- Minor alterations to glove tutorial and ring tutorial inscriptions
- Room layout changes to hopefully make it clearer where to go
- A difficult puzzle was simplified
- Max capacity of platforms removed, not that it mattered anyways.
- General dialogue changes especially to the lengthy sections to make them a little more interesting
   - "You" also talk a bit more with the voice


Fixes:
- Fixed logbook sometimes having multiple empty lines before a filled one.
- General optimization to game performance


Roadmap:
- Revamp of tutorials
- More sound effects
- Day to night transition depending on game progress

notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.content:
Update 1 Patch Notes:

New Stuff:
- Climbing system has been reworked to allow more oomph when jumping off walls
- Discord and Steam wishlist buttons added to main menu


Changes:
- New sky background
- New [spoiler] Underworld [/spoiler] background
- Minor alterations to parallax of backgrounds
- Snow texture changed
- Movement values tweaked slightly


Fixes:
- Dialogue at end of demo changed from saying "go left for this and left for that" to "go left for this and RIGHT for that" 
- Heavy optimisation with area transitions.




There was a few other things I did but I forgot to write them down.

Roadmap:
- New backgrounds
- Bloom effect
- Other graphical stuff
- New soundtracks 
- New cover art.
